definitions.explanation: The state of being in violation of or contrary to the constitution. A key term in Japanese legal and political discourse, especially regarding Article 9 and other constitutional debates.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{違憲|いけん}だ。
⟦{裁判所|さいばんしょ}→裁判所：09665_saibansho⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{違憲|いけん}⟦{判決|はんけつ}→判決：05906_hanketsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|くだ}した→下す：12329_kudasu⟧。
examples.english: The court handed down a ruling of unconstitutionality.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{法案|ほうあん}→法案：09758_houan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{憲法|けんぽう}→憲法：02744_kenpou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{反|はん}する→反する：11966_hansuru⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{法学者|ほうがくしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{違憲|いけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{可能性|かのうせい}→可能性：04818_kanousei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{指摘|してき}→指摘：05630_shiteki⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Many legal scholars have pointed out the possibility that this bill is unconstitutional, as it violates the constitution.

notes:
USAGE: {違憲|いけん} is a legal term frequently used in Japanese political and constitutional debates. It is the opposite of ⟦{合憲|ごうけん}→合憲：20964_gouken⟧ (constitutional).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {違憲|いけん}⟦{判決|はんけつ}→判決：05906_hanketsu⟧: ruling of unconstitutionality
- {違憲|いけん}⟦{審査|しんさ}→審査：08375_shinsa⟧: judicial/constitutional review
- {違憲|いけん}⟦{訴訟|そしょう}→訴訟：07642_soshou⟧: constitutional lawsuit
- {違憲|いけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{疑|うたが}い→疑い：09757_utagai⟧: suspicion of unconstitutionality
- {違憲|いけん}⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧: state of unconstitutionality

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {違憲|いけん}: unconstitutional
- ⟦{合憲|ごうけん}→合憲：20964_gouken⟧: constitutional (in accordance with the constitution)
- ⟦{違法|いほう}→違法：09687_ihou⟧: illegal (in violation of a law, broader than the constitution)
